mcp:tool-listener.name: get_property_details
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: get_property_details - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Get full details for one Ascott property: description, images, location, amenities, check-in times, policies and its lead-in price for the stay. Identify the property by propertyCode, or by propertyName when no code is known. Read-only; creates and changes nothing.
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"propertyCode": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 20, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", "description": "Ascott property code, e.g. 8791. Give this or propertyName."}, "propertyName": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 200}, "checkin": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", "description": "Check-in, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to a near-term stay when omitted."}, "checkout": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", "description": "Check-out, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkin."}, "adults": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10, "default": 1}, "children": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10, "default": 0}, "currency": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Za-z]{3}$", "description": "ISO 4217 code, e.g. SGD."}, "language": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$", "default": "en"}, "maxPois": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 5, "description": "Nearby points of interest to include."}}, "anyOf": [{"required": ["propertyCode"]}, {"required": ["propertyName"]}]}

mcp:tool-listener.name: compareProperties
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: compareProperties - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Return two to four named Ascott properties side by side in one payload, each with its name, images, location, room types, amenities and lead-in price for the same stay and the same currency. It does not rank or recommend: weigh the properties yourself from the data returned. Read-only; creates and changes nothing.
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"propertyCodes": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 20, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"}, "minItems": 2, "maxItems": 4, "uniqueItems": true, "description": "Two to four Ascott property codes to return side by side."}, "checkinDate": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", "description": "Check-in, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days out."}, "checkoutDate": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", "description": "Check-out, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the day after check-in."}, "noOfadults": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10, "default": 1}, "noOfchildren": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10, "default": 0}, "currencyCode": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Za-z]{3}$", "description": "ISO 4217 code, e.g. SGD. Every card uses this one currency."}, "language": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Za-z]{2,4})?$", "default": "en"}}, "required": ["propertyCodes"]}

mcp:tool-listener.name: createBooking
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Create Booking. Uses simulated ODX data in the local profile. WRITE operation. Creates a reservation only after explicit user approval of property, stay, guest and price. Pass confirmed=true and the quoted expectedTotal, currency and rateId. Use a stable idempotencyKey. Never retry with a new key after a timeout.
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"propertyId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 100, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"}, "roomId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 100, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"}, "rateId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 100, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"}, "checkIn": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"}, "checkOut": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"}, "adults": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 6}, "guest": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 100}, "email": {"type": "string", "format": "email", "maxLength": 254}}, "required": ["name", "email"]}, "confirmed": {"type": "boolean", "description": "True only after the user explicitly approves this property, dates and quoted total."}, "expectedTotal": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0}, "currency": {"type": "string", "enum": ["SGD"]}, "idempotencyKey": {"type": "string", "minLength": 8, "maxLength": 64, "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", "description": "Stable identifier for this booking attempt. Reuse on retries; never change after an uncertain outcome."}}, "required": ["propertyId", "roomId", "rateId", "checkIn", "checkOut", "adults", "guest", "confirmed", "expectedTotal", "currency", "idempotencyKey"]}
